_comment: Tier-2: TANGENT_OPERATOR_ESTIMATION selects how the generic isotropic plasticity laws build their tangent; the default second-order perturbation tangent throws condition-number errors, 0 makes Newton stagnate, and 3 (secant) is the robust choice. Pitfall (kratos.constitutive_laws #3). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The variable resolves on ConstitutiveLawsApplication and NOT on core, and a Properties object round-trips the value 3 the claim recommends. Nothing validates the setting — the failure the claim describes is a diverging Newton residual at run time, so the knob's existence and its home module are what a fixture can hold. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
